This example showed that fitting a polynomial directly to G cannot reproduce the x ln x end-point shape and produces spurious two-phase regions (fcc+fcc, liquid+liquid), so the policy of separating the ideal-mixing term analytically and fitting only the excess term (A in Fig. 1, ideal_T) was adopted.
